player_prompt.intro:
Aletɔwo Sokoban ƒe agbalẽ. Ame nyuiɖela ɖo, eye wòazu bɔksiwo katã ɖo alɔdodo.
        Ne wòle bɔksia ɖe, wòazu bɔksia ɖo didi mɔfɛa.
        Meɖe bɔksia ɖo go, eye meɖe bɔksia ɖo.
        Agbalẽa, nukpɔsesɛwo nye: 
        - Nyuiɖela (wò) ƒe 'P' 
        - Go tɔwo ƒe '#' 
        - Bɔksiwo ƒe 'X' 
        - Alɔdodo siwo wu ƒe 'O'
        - Bɔksi siwo le alɔdodo la ƒe '√'
        Wòazu [w] ɖe dzi, [a] ɖe gbɔ, [s] ɖe anyi, kple [d] ɖe ɣe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Gbɔsɔsɔa xɔxɔ sia mɛfɔ nu o. Ɖɔɖɔɖɔ [up], [down], [left], [right] alo [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Dɔ si nède asii la menye dɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ o.
invalid_move.wall_collision: Màte ŋu aʋu ayi gli me o!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Ʋu si mele se nu o - mate ŋu aʋui ayi teƒe ma o.

game_message.pushed_prefix: Eʋã aɖaka aɖe esime wònɔ mɔa dzi.

outcome.win: Makafu wò! Èkpɔ Sokoban ƒe nya ɣaɣla la gbɔ.
outcome.turn_limit: Miele mɔa dzi o. Miekpɔ nya la gbɔ o.
